name: v4.0.543
body:
## What's Changed

- `@remotion/studio`: **Add audio level meters** by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13146
- **remotion.pro is retired, buy a license now at https://www.remotion.dev/pricing instead**
- [`@remotion/cli`: Add `open-timeline import` and `canvas-capture import`](https://remotion.dev/docs/cli/open-timeline/import) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13148
- [`@remotion/renderer`: Add `chromiumOptions.flags` to override Chrome flags](https://remotion.dev/docs/options/chromium-flags) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13147
- [`@remotion/renderer`: Add `proResBitsPerMacroblock` for ProRes file size control](https://remotion.dev/docs/options/prores-bits-per-macroblock) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13220
- [`@remotion/studio`: Add movable playback diagnostics](https://remotion.dev/docs/options/show-diagnostics) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13224
- `@remotion/studio`: Create `<Track>`s by right-clicking by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13289
- `remotion`: Fix `<HtmlInCanvas>` flicker when resizing by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13222
- `remotion`: Stop `<CanvasImage>` from reloading when `onError` is inline by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13238
- remotion.new: Install required auxiliary packages with Elements by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13154
- remotion.new: Pin transitive dependency versions in fallback bundle, avoid ephemeral e2e port by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13203
- `@remotion/cli`: Fix `remotion elements` errors and docs that disagree with the command by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13151
- `@remotion/cli`: Reload the config again when it changes during a reload by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13260
- `@remotion/lambda`: Fix process crashes on chunk file write errors by @anthod0 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13170
- `@remotion/media`: Fix duplicate redraw after ready and apply volume on mount by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13196
- `@remotion/media`: Skip audio initialization when muted or disabled by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13221
- `@remotion/media`: Call `onError` once and show the error fallback when a preview fails by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13247
- `@remotion/player`: Fix audio interruptions from late preview frames by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12519
- `@remotion/player`: Reduce bundle size by 10% by sharing code between `remotion` and `remotion/no-react` by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13172
- `@remotion/player`: Fix buffering indicator not shown when buffering restarts within one frame by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13213
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix replacement browser not closed after crash by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13188
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix port lock not released when port selection throws by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13189
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix CDP connection teardown running twice by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13190
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix asset download hanging after invalid data URL by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13191
- `@remotion/skills`: Make Studio interactivity the default by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13133
- `@remotion/skills`: Use `.element.tsx` file names and full Element index links for agents by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13156
- `@remotion/studio`: Keep the timeline zoom anchor fixed for the whole gesture by @VAbhijeetCD in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13103
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix effect inspector selection and reordering by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13141
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix effect reorder indicators and history by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13142
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix Element Library names in the Browse Elements menu by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13152
- `@remotion/studio`: Add source actions to Effects context menu by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13185
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix element insert selection and default props races, harden e2e tests by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13195
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix timeline editing, playback and agent state by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13233
- `@remotion/studio`: Show why a render could not be queued by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13239
- `@remotion/studio`: Jump to selected props and effects when opening source by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13245
- `@remotion/studio`: Reconnect after the server answers `/events` with an error by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13261
- `@remotion/studio`: Keep sequence-props subscriptions stable during effect edits by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13292
- `@remotion/studio-server`: Fix Studio discovery routing to the wrong tab by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13120
- `@remotion/studio-server`: Fix missing assets when public folder is created by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13252
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Render SVG filter regions with offsets by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13037
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Render referenced SVG polygon and path clips by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13100
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Render referenced clips with multiple rectangles by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13108
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix doubled opacity on root SVG elements by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13111
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix rounding of CSS transform matrices by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13112
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Composite opaque `renderMediaOnWeb()` output against black by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13114
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Preserve uncropped SVG blob content by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13116
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Preserve disabled SVG stylesheet state by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13118
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Add `mask-composite` for multiple raster masks by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13129
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Preserve positioned children during filter capture by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13140
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Restore SVG fallback when a font family is removed by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13145
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Resolve percentages and CSS math in `text-decoration-thickness` by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13158
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Close video frames when `renderMediaOnWeb()` fails by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13160
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Resolve CSS math in `mask-size` by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13162
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix composition props retained after unmount by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13164
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Keep readiness checks ticking after a worker error by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13168
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Restore inline styles after transform measurement by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13171

## Elements

- Define Element descriptions only in the Element registry by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13157

## Templates

- `template-stargazer`: Require GitHub authentication to fetch stargazers by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13296

## Docs

- Migrate public links and website guidance to remotion.dev by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12808
- Clarify which organizations qualify as non-profits for the Free License by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12907
- Condense client-side rendering limitations by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13122
- Use the Pro production backend for account routes by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13130
- Publish standalone version 4.0 policies by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13139
- Update the company address and keep 4.0 policies indexable by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13149
- Fix inaccuracies in the Element authoring and library guides by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13155
- Add soundza to sound effect resources by @vfseanm in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13167
- Fix list of components that support effects by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13173
- Fix `getAvailableEmojis()` name and `scale` values for `@remotion/animated-emoji` by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13174

- Document parameter limits on effect pages by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13181
- Document missing `<Audio>` and `<Video>` props from `@remotion/media` by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13182
- Name `encodingBufferSize` and `encodingMaxRate` correctly on render APIs by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13198
- Make `delayRender()` pages follow the `useDelayRender()` pattern by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13199
- Align Lambda Go, Ruby and Python guides with the SDKs by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13200
- Fix Lambda CLI pages that disagree with the code by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13201
- Fix core function pages that disagree with the code by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13202
- Fix core component props that disagree with the code by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13207
- Align Lambda bucket and infrastructure guides with the source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13208
- Align `@remotion/layout-utils`, `@remotion/lottie` and licensing pages with the source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13209
- Fix inconsistencies in the font pages by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13210
- Fix `@remotion/sdk` version markers and sibling-page inconsistencies by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13211
- Add orphaned pages to the sidebar and fix their inconsistencies by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13212
- Align terminology and miscellaneous pages with the source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13214
- Resolve conflicting Player guidance and page labels by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13215
- Align crumbs on API reference pages with their siblings by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13216
- Make the disk size page the single source for Lambda video length limits by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13217
- Clarify that `renderMedia()` takes a private license key by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13219
- Serve compliance pages on remotion.dev by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13223
- Add dailysounds.org to sound effect resources by @jaydenhertz in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13225
- Use the real `--cross-site-isolation` flag in the Studio CLI example by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13229
- Correct the printed path in the makeEllipse() and makeCircle() examples by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13230
- List missing Lambda light client exports and price regions by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13240
- Fix facts on contributing, migration and upgrading pages by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13241
- Remove "simply" and "just" from prose by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13242
- Match Canvas Capture, browser bundler and Timeline docs to source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13243
- Remove sound source links from @remotion/sfx pages by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13246
- New post about our latest tutorial by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13253
- Align rendering guides with the renderer source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13254
- Align getting started and Studio guides with templates and Studio by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13255
- Fix @remotion/paths and @remotion/motion-blur examples and facts by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13256
- Match troubleshooting pages to current error messages by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13257
- List all inherited Sequence props and effectsOutputSize on components by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13258
- Align video and audio guides with @remotion/media by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13259
- Align Whisper package pages with the source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13262
- Align Lambda guides and API pages with the source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13263
- Align visuals and parameterization guides with the source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13264

- Align @remotion/media-utils pages with the source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13269

- Align Mediabunny and FAQ pages with the source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13275
- Align @remotion/shapes pages with the source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13276
- Align @remotion/transitions pages with the source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13277

- Fix CLI and config pages that disagree with the code by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13282

- Align @remotion/player pages with the source by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13285
- Format API names in prose as linked code by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13286
- Document option and return fields as headings by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13287
- Fix broken /compliance link on the legal page by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13299

## Internal and Experimental

- `@remotion/studio-protocol`: Apply the same Element payload limits when creating and parsing payloads by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13153
- `@remotion/design`: Keep translated Select values safe during navigation by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13131
- `@remotion/promo-pages`: Clarify which plan seats belong to in homepage pricing by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13132
- remotion.dev/convert: Fix error when canceling a conversion by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13127
- Use a local image for the CORS regression test by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13121
- Retain original PNGs for native pixel failures by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13144
- Keep Lambda bucket-listing checks inside fake AWS by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13159
- `@remotion/cli`: Fix flaky Windows timeout in linked worktree Git source test by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13183
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix flaky CSS math mask-size test timeouts by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13186
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Speed up slow native-comparison tests by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13193
- `@remotion/it-tests`: Fix root causes of retried rendering tests and remove retries by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13194
- Fix flaky codemods, bundler, studio and lambda tests by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13197
- `@remotion/timeline-utils`: Use local media fixtures in tests instead of the CDN by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13204
- Fix flaky docs, renderer, lambda, PHP and Studio upgrade tests by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13205
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Warm up native reference painting before comparison tests by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13226
- Overlap PNG encoding in mask sizing tests by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13234
